prompt:
A high-fidelity visual design mockup of a MOBILE WEB PAGE, portrait phone viewport, full-bleed screen design. Flat screen design only: no phone hardware frame, no browser chrome, no hands, no desk, no device photograph, no shadow around the screen. It is a birthday party invitation page.

STRUCTURE, top to bottom, as regions of a web page. There is no navigation bar; the page opens directly on its subject.

REGION 1, occupying the top 80% of the screen edge to edge: one single deep varnished navy-blue wooden nameboard filling the full width of the screen, like the transom of a wooden boat. Its border is a hand-laid gilded rope moulding running around all four edges, with a small round brass bolt at each of the four corners. The navy varnish has visible depth and a soft warm highlight in its upper left. Inside this plate, arranged in strict centred symmetry with generous breathing room:
  a) The words HBD SUMMER PARTY set very large across the plate in three stacked lines of a heavy high-contrast signwriter's roman capital, lettered in real gold leaf with a bright chisel highlight along the top of each stroke and a hard black signwriter's shade dropped down and to the right. This is the largest thing on the screen.
  b) Directly beneath it, centred, a gilded emblem the width of about one third of the screen: a birthday cake with exactly FIVE slim lit candles, the whole cake framed inside a circular life ring. Cake, ring and candles are all drawn in the same flat gold-leaf signwriter grammar with two-tone chisel facets. The five candle flames are the ONLY warm orange in the entire image, small and bright.
  c) Beneath the emblem, a smaller centred line of Korean text reading 어반피크닉 워터파티룸 · 분당서현, set in a quiet warm serif, in pale gold.
  d) Beneath that, a single even horizontal row of exactly FIVE identical small gold five-pointed stars, evenly spaced, all precisely the same size, none emphasised.
  e) At the base of the plate, the line 2026.08.28 FRI 17:00 in a small tracked stencil typeface, cut INTO the varnish as an engraved incision with a thin light edge above and shadow below, not raised.

REGION 2, the bottom 20% of the screen: a full-bleed band of clear pool water in warm teal-aqua, its surface an actual rippling waterline with a pale crest highlight, meeting the bottom edge of the navy plate.

PALETTE, strictly: deep varnished navy, real gold leaf, sun-bleached sand cream, pool aqua-teal, and one small flame orange used only at the five candles. Warm, celebratory, orderly, classic maritime softened with warmth. Crisp, structured, symmetrical, generous negative space, absolutely not a busy collage.

No people, no faces, no logos, no photographs, no prices, no buttons other than what is described, no invented text beyond the words specified.
